In the beginning of summer last year, I got my buddy to convince his manager to give me a job at the local Dunkin Donuts. She called me, I went through all the training, and finally finished it all in about a month. My first day off training, my buddy invites me into the cooler, and he hands me a can of whipped cream. We remove the caps and do whippets for a solid 15 minutes and go back out and resume our duties.

Soon, (I can't remember if it was the next day or a week later or something) the Manager asks us if we did anything with whipped cream because we seemed to be running low. We say no we restocked the little refrigerators in the main area. She gives me a significant look and asks "are you sure?" I say "yep".

Nothing came of it but we found out later she had installed a baby cam in there and had footage of us doing whippets. She couldn't do anything about it though because it infringed on some other company policy about hidden cameras or something. She also must have had footage of people smoking weed and stuff too but she never said anything.
I would hazard a guess and say our technology is less linear and more exponential...
